layout_sources: https://github.com/firefly-iii/import-configurations/blob/main/pl/santander/default.json (comma; "headers": true, i.e. the first line is skipped; date d-m-Y; 9 columns: ignored, transaction date, description, counterparty name, counterparty IBAN, amount, ignored, ignored, ignored)
notes: Santander internet "Historia" CSV. No header row: the first line is an account summary (period, account number, account name, currency, opening and closing balance, number of lines; its exact fields are not confirmed), then one line per transaction: operation date, booking date (DD-MM-YYYY), description, counterparty, counterparty account, amount, balance after the line, line number, and a trailing comma. Comma-separated with comma-decimal amounts, so amounts and balances are double-quoted ("-1100,00"). Newest first. Encoding (UTF-8 assumed) and line ends not confirmed. Expected dates are the booking dates (column 2, the one Firefly III reads).
